title: Casa Rayrae | KEY.co
description_expanded: This stunning property in the exclusive gated community of Cabo Colorado offers an unparalleled escape in San Jose del Cabo, just minutes from the beach. With four spacious bedrooms, each featuring a king bed, en-suite bathroom, and private outdoor access, the home is designed for comfort and luxury. The expansive terrace invites relaxation and outdoor dining, overlooking a pristine infinity pool and jacuzzi that blend seamlessly with the ocean views. Inside, the sophisticated kitchen and grand dining area provide a perfect setting for hosting unforgettable gatherings, all while surrounded by elegance. Located in one of Cabo's most sought-after areas, the home offers convenient access to a private beach, premium restaurants, and essential amenities, all within a five-minute drive. The master suite on the main floor stands as a sanctuary, complete with dual vanities and a hot tub for the ultimate retreat experience. Combining contemporary design with luxurious features, this residence ensures an exceptional stay where relaxation, sophistication, and natural beauty come together effortlessly.
